announcement.quote: A Special Meeting of Shareholders of the RidgeWorth Capital Innovations Global Resources and Infrastructure Fund (the “Acquired Fund”), a series of RidgeWorth Funds (the “Trust”), has been scheduled for June 28, 2017 (the “Special Meeting”).

deals.notes: Acquiring fund is a newly created series of Investment Managers Series Trust (CIK 1318342 is the trust). Listing status and outcome are not stated in the excerpts.

announcement.quote: called to vote on a proposal to reorganize the Acquired Fund into the AAM/Phocas Real Estate Fund (the “Acquiring Fund”) (the “Reorganization”), a newly created series of Investment Managers Series Trust (“IMST”).

deals.notes: Target is a series of Forum Funds II; acquirer a newly created series of Investment Managers Series Trust. Special meeting scheduled for August 13, 2018. Listing status and outcome are not stated in the excerpts.

problems: The CIK is a fund trust (Investment Managers Series Trust), so episode_role is 'other'. The window also mentions further reorganizations whose excerpts are only headers: Horizon Spin-off and Corporate Restructuring Fund (supplement filed by Kinetics Mutual Funds, Inc., CIK 1083387, 2017-11-16), Center Coast MLP Focus Fund (filed by Brookfield Investment Funds, CIK 1520738, 2017-12-14 and 2018-01-05; special meeting January 23, 2018), and Oak Ridge Small Cap Growth Fund (filed by North Square Investments Trust, CIK 1750821, 2019-02-15). The excerpts name no acquiring fund or outcome for them, so they are not recorded as deals. Palmer Square advisory agreement proxies in 2018 are not mergers.
